findings.english_quote: and they have not known what wickedness is
findings.issue: The selected reading is translated compatibly, but its critical marks receive no disclosure. The source also marks part of ἔσεσθε and ἐκ and brackets [καὶ]. Neither the reader text nor its accompanying metadata distinguishes these marked portions from unmarked preserved text. The general source-basis statement does not explain these particular marks.
findings.suggested_revision: Retain the source-compatible working translation, but add a concise note identifying the marked portions and explaining their editorial status according to the working edition. If the precise significance of a mark is not established by the supplied report, obtain that explanation rather than asserting fresh manuscript verification. Distinguish the marked letters from the entire words.

findings.source_quote: οἱ τοιοῦτοι οὖν ἀδιστάκτως κατοικοῦσιν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὅτι ἐν οὐδενὶ πράγματι ἐμίαναν τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ Θεοῦ
findings.english_quote: People like this live without hesitation in God’s kingdom. They have not defiled God’s commandments in any matter.
findings.issue: The simplified edition omits the explicit causal connection expressed by ὅτι. It presents two adjacent assertions instead of stating that their undefiled observance is the reason given for their dwelling in God's kingdom.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed correction for fresh review: “People like this live without hesitation in God’s kingdom because they have not defiled God’s commandments in any matter.”

findings.issue: The explicit temporal request νῦν, “now,” is omitted. It connects the new request to the completion of the mountain parables.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed correction for fresh review: “Sir, now explain to me”.

findings.english_quote: Retain name-bearing suffering, healing and gift language, infant innocence, stone/root/wealth imagery and all critical footnotes without turning editorial supply into unanimous manuscript text.
findings.issue: The simplified edition provides no critical footnotes explaining the selected source's marked portions, despite its metadata claiming retention of all critical footnotes. Its unqualified rendering of the marked reading, together with similarly undisclosed marks in ἔσεσθε and ἐκ and the bracketed [καὶ], does not distinguish editorial intervention from preserved text.
findings.suggested_revision: Add a source-specific note explaining the marked portions according to the working edition, without claiming authentication of unseen manuscripts. Revise the simplification metadata to describe the actual disclosures supplied for this unit rather than claiming retention of absent footnotes.

summary: Both editions broadly preserve the selected Greek passage, its speakers, negations, infant imagery, and difficult assertions about priority and life to God. The standard edition needs disclosure of the source's critical marks. The simplified edition independently also loses an explicit causal connection and “now,” and its footnote-retention metadata does not match the supplied apparatus. The bounded Amherst report concerns the following section and does not resolve this unit's marked readings. These are model-review findings against the supplied working source, not manuscript authentication or exhaustive scholarly certification; proposed wording requires fresh review.
